description: Published TripleLift xuid, getuid and sync parameter contracts. Partner dongles, redirect allowlists, geographical applicability and browser cookies require external context.

params.name: mid
params.description: TripleLift explicitly requires the buyer member ID to be a positive integer. It is assigned by TripleLift, with no locally testable registry.

params.name: xuid
params.description: The /xuid endpoint stores this opaque buyer identifier.

params.name: dongle
params.description: TripleLift provides this opaque partner mapping code. Its account association requires external configuration.

params.name: redir
params.description: The documented redirect destination is an encoded absolute URL. $UID is substituted by TripleLift. The decoded URL is checked here; raw query encoding and the allowlist are separate limitations.

params.name: gdpr
params.description: GDPR territory is signaled as 1; the published quick-check example also uses 0.

params.name: gdpr_consent
params.description: An IAB TCF consent string is accepted under gdpr_consent or cmp_cs. Consent fields are optional, but absent or invalid consent prevents GDPR sync.

params.name: us_privacy
params.description: Optional CCPA signal uses the IAB US Privacy string.

params.name: gpp_sid
params.description: The IAB URL macro specification defines one applicable section ID or at most two comma-separated IDs. This limit applies to URL macros, not the unrestricted JS API array.

rules.message: A documented /xuid mapping call supplies mid, xuid and the partner dongle. The documentation does not publish a rejection schema for absence.
The documented getuid and sync flows supply an encoded redir destination.
TripleLift will not perform a GDPR sync without a valid consent string. Consent parameters themselves are explicitly optional.
GPP sync signals are documented as an encoded string and applicable section IDs.
Applicable GPP IDs need the corresponding encoded consent string.
Applicable GPP section IDs must identify sections in the encoded consent header.

params.name: method
params.description: The documented browser redirect flow uses HTTPS GET.
